en: The catalog of the teachings brought by Master Huìyùn consists of one hundred and eighty fascicles,
including mantra sūtras and ritual manuals (*vidhi*),
together with one fascicle of the *Vajrayoginī-sūtra*.
The *Tattvārthā-nāma-tantra-ṭīkā* (Commentary on the Meaning of Reality), two fascicles; the *Mahāmāyūrī-vidyārājñī-sūtra*, three fascicles;
the *Vajraśekhara-sūtra*, two fascicles; the *Mahācakra-vajra-dhāraṇī-sūtra*, one fascicle; the *Sūryadevatā-mahādevī-sūtra*, one fascicle;
the *Aṣṭamahābodhisattva-maṇḍala-sūtra*, one fascicle; and the *Vaiśravaṇa-rāja-amṛta-kumāra-sūtra*, one fascicle.
*The Sūtra of Avalokiteśvara, the Supreme Vidyārāja*, one fascicle; *The Sūtra of Yamāntaka*, one fascicle; *The Sūtra of Ucchuṣma*, two fascicles;
*The Sūtra on the Realm of All Buddhas*, three fascicles; *The Sūtra of Tārā Spoken by Avalokiteśvara*, one fascicle; *The Sūtra of the Vajra Youth*, three fascicles;
*The Sūtra of the Most Victorious Prolongation of Life*, one fascicle; and *The Daughter of the Yakṣa Kanyā*.
*Sūtra* in one fascicle; *Xuanyun suyao jing* (The Sūtra of Mysterious Melodies and Ancient Radiance) in one fascicle; *Nianzhu jing* (Sūtra on the Prayer Beads) in one fascicle;
*Santingchu jing* (Sūtra on the Three-Pavilion Kitchen) in one fascicle; *Commentary on the Sanskrit Prajñāpāramitā-hṛdaya Sūtra* in one fascicle; *Mahāhīya-dāna Sūtra* in three fascicles;
*Cundī-devī Dhāraṇī Sūtra* in three fascicles; *Vajraśekhara Sūtra* in six fascicles; *Commentary on the Vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in one fascicle; *Niu...* [text fragment].
*The Commentary on the Diamond Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* in one fascicle by Chan Master Tōzan;
*The Imperially Composed Ritual Manual for the Mantra of the Flaming Splendor of the Buddha-uṣṇīṣa* in one fascicle; *The Ritual Manual of the Vajraśekhara Samādhi* in one fascicle;
*The Ritual Manual of the Lotus Sūtra* in one fascicle; *The Ritual Manual of the Extraordinary [Deity]* in one fascile; and *The Greatly Majestic and Wrathful Ucchuṣma*.
One fascicle on the *Sādhana-vidhi*; one fascicle on the *Rājanīya-prajñāpāramitā-vidhi*; one fascicle on the *Vajraśekhara-paramādya-mahāvajra-vidhi*;
one fascicle on the *Bathing-the-Image-vidhi*; one fascicle on the *Consecration-vidhi*;
one fascicle on the *Śākya-rudana-vidhi*; one fascicle on the *Bodhicitta-vidhi*; one fascicle on the *Ākāśagarbha-japa-dharma*; and the *Fourfold Accomplishment* (*Catur-siddhi*).
*The Dharma*, one fascicle; *The Yoga of Mañjuśrī’s Five Syllables*, one fascicle; *The Method for Establishing the Maṇḍala*, one fascicle;
*The Dharma of Pañcaraśmi Mañjuśrī*, one fascicle; *The Dharma of Hārītī*, one fascicle; *The Vajratuṇḍa Dharma*, one fascicle;
*The Great Tathāgata-Usnīṣa Great Maṇḍala Dharma*, one fascicle; *The Vināyaka Dharma*, one fascicle.
*The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Recitation Method*, two fascicles (upper and lower); *The Avalokiteśvara Tārā Recitation Method*, one fascicle;
*The Recitation Method for the Ekākṣara-uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin*, one fascicle; *The Separate Practice Method for the Lokadhara Dhāraṇī Sūtra*, one fascicle;
*The Recitation Method for the Padmakula Maitreya-hṛdaya Bodhisattva*, one fascicle; *The Separate Practice Achievement Method for the Uṣṇīṣavijayā*.
One fascicle on the Method of Samantabhadra-Vajrasattva; one fascicle on the Method of Avalokiteśvara, the Great Compassionate King with the Blue Neck;
two fascicles on the Recitation Method of Mahāvairocana; one fascicle on the Method of Mañjuśrī;
one fascicle on the Method of Tilakasamādhi; one fascicle on the Method of Acala; one fascicle on the Inner Homa Method; [and] the Method of Acala.

*Fǎ* (Dharma), one fascicle; *Bǎozàngtiān Fǎ* (Ratnagarbha-deva Dharma), one fascicle; *Móhēshǒulú Fǎ* (Maheśvara Dharma), one fascicle; *Qīyào Xīngchén Biéxíng Fǎ* (Separate Practice of the Seven Luminaries and Constellations), one fascicle;
*Wǔ Zàn* (Five Praises), one fascicle; *Jíqìng Zàn* (Praise of Auspiciousness and Joy), one fascicle; *Bílúzhēnaxīn Zàn* (Praise of the Heart of Vairocana), one fascicle;

*Pǔxián Xíngyuàn Zàn* (Praise of Samantabhadra’s Vows and Practices), one fascicle; *Shìjiā Chéngdào Jiàngmó Zàn* (Praise of Śākyamuni’s Attainment of Enlightenment and Subjugation of Māra), one fascicle; [Śākyamuni...].
*The Praise of the Thousand-Spoked Wheel*, one fascicle; *The Praise of the Bodhisattva Mahāvairocana*, one fascicle; *The Praise of the Wish-Fulfilling Gem*, one fascicle;
*General Explanation of the Meaning of Dhāraṇīs*, one fascicle; *The Dhāraṇī of Fragrant Victory*, one fascicle; *The Dhāraṇī of the Great Buddha-Uṣṇīṣa*, one fascicle;
*The Dhāraṇī of the Universal Rescue*, one fascicle; *Commentary on the Dhāraṇī of the Great Buddha-Uṣṇīṣa*, one fascicle.
*Uṣṇīṣavijayā-dhāraṇī*, one fascicle; *Sarvatathāgatatatvasaṃgraha-dhāraṇī*, one fascicle;
*Daśāmṛta-mantra*, one fascicle; *Mantras in Sanskrit Script*, twelve fascicles; *Vairocanābhisambodhi-mantra*, one fascicle;
*Siddham Chapter Diagrams*, one fascicle; *Siddham Sanskrit Script*, one fascicle; *Siddham Record*, one fascicle; [Works by] Samantabhadra.
One fascicle of the *Praise in Sanskrit*; one fascicle of the Sanskrit original of the *Śata-dharma-śāstra*; one fascicle of the Sanskrit original of the *Triṃśikā-vijñapti-bhāṣya*;
two sheets of the *Kṣitigarbha-mantra*; one fascicle of the *Essential Summary of the Cintāmaṇicakra-dhāraṇī-sūtra*;
one scroll of the *Commentary on the Mahāpūrṇa Sūtra* (the *Ullambana Sūtra*) by Kaizi; another fascicle of the same commentary by the same author; and the *Record of the Vimalakīrti-nirdeśa-sūtra*.

One fascicle of the *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra Commentary*; one work in three fascicles, the *Commentary on the Compendium of the Four-Part Vinaya* (*Sifen lü shanfan buque xingshi chao zuanyuan ji*);

one work in ten fascicles; one fascicle of the *Commentary on the Chapter on Kalpas* (*Jiezhang shu*); one fascicle of the *Record of the Chapter on Kalpas* (*Jiezhang ji*); one fascicle of the *Record of the Meaning of the Ritual for Lamenting for Śākyas* (*Shishi ku yi yi ji*);

one fascicle of the *Record of the Successive Transmission of the Dharma by the Immortal Patriarchs of the Western Regions* (*Xiguo xianzu daixiang chengchuan faji*); and the *Treatise Distinguishing the Orthodoxy and Heterodoxy of Chan Views* (*Bian chan jianjie xiezheng lun*).
One fascicle of the *Bodhidharmalun*; one fascicle of the *Kṣemakalpavarnana-gatha*; one fascicle of the *Vajrakarni*;

seventeen sections of the *Souxuanji* (Record of Searching the Profound); one fascicle of the *Wubu Zhangjue* (Manual of Mudras for the Five Families); one register of the inscription for the Great Master of Baen Temple;
and one fascicle of the *Dashing Wenshu Bimimi Duanluo Ni Xiuxing Cidi* (The Sequence of Practice for the Secret Dhāraṇī of the Great Sage Mañjuśrī).
*Trailokyavijaya-vajra-guhyavidhi-vidyā-dvāra*, one fascicle; *Vajraśekhara-cittabhūmi-vidyā-dvāra*, one fascicle;
*Dharmadhātu-samantadvāra*, one fascicle; *Triṃśatsaptadevatotpatti-artha*, two fascicles; *Yoga-yaojue*, one fascicle;
*Commentary on the Mahākaruṇā-mantra*, one sheet; *Lüji yinque biaozhi shiyi*, one fascicle; [Compiled by] Wufei.

*Sanzang zhuan* (Biographies of the Tripitaka Masters), three fascicles; *Zhigong ge* (Songs of Master Zhi), one fascicle; *Yixing liubingren ge* (The Six-Branched Ren Method Songs of Yixing), one work in two parts;

*Shangxia daoxing ge* (Songs on the Nature of the Way, Upper and Lower), one fascicle; *Shoujie chanhui wen* (Text on Receiving Precepts and Repenting Sins), one fascicle; *Jinshizi zhang* (Treatise on the Golden Lion), one fascicle; *Jiezhang* (Treatise on Kalpas), one fascicle;

*Nanshan chao kewen* (Outline of the Nanshan Commentary), one fascicle; *Huan yuan ji* (Collection on Returning to the Source), one work in three fascicles; *Yunju ji* (Collection from Yunju), one work.
Volume Two. Herein is respectfully recorded the number of Buddha relics, Sanskrit manuscripts, mantra scriptures, images, altar offerings, and ritual implements brought from the Great Tang.
The thirtieth day of the sixth month, the fourteenth year of Jōwa.
